comparison.objective: Control a carton descending a parcel slide so it reaches the dock without running away; candidate tunes damper response through repeated guarded impacts.
comparison.physical_skill: Continuous braking/restraint of a translating carton versus hex-key use, collar adjustment, locking, control actuation, and response-based iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Runaway and dock-arrival thresholds are unspecified; candidate requires two repeatable stops within published energy, velocity, and stroke limits with no hard-stop strike or drift.
comparison.reason: Both concern motion control, but direct carton restraint is different from configuring and locking an energy absorber.
